name: Migrant Smuggling
description: Facilitation of illegal border crossings for payment, typically organised by networks which collect fees from migrants or their families, often through informal value transfer, and spend on transport, documents and accommodation. Unlike trafficking, consent is initial, but exploitation and abuse are common risks.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risks Arising from Migrant Smuggling (2022)
UNODC, Global Study on Smuggling of Migrants (2018)
FATF, Money Laundering Risks Arising from Trafficking in Human Beings and Smuggling of Migrants (2011)
Europol and Interpol, public material on migrant smuggling networks

exposure.rationale: Fees collected from migrants and families via remittance, hawala-type guarantees and cash; recruitment advertised on social platforms.

indicators.name: Family remittances for 'travel arrangements' to unfamiliar counterparties
indicators.canon: Family remittances for 'travel arrangements' to unfamiliar counterparties
indicators.desc: Repeated transfers from diaspora senders to third-country individuals with messages about journeys or guarantees.
indicators.ctx: Repeated transfers from diaspora senders to third-country individuals with messages about journeys or guarantees.
indicators.fp: Families fund legitimate travel and relocation.

indicators.name: Guarantee or escrow payments through informal value transfer
indicators.canon: Guarantee or escrow payments through informal value transfer
indicators.desc: Funds held by an agent and released only upon arrival, sometimes via hawala-type providers.
indicators.ctx: Funds held by an agent and released only upon arrival, sometimes via hawala-type providers.
indicators.fp: Informal remittance is used widely for legitimate reasons.

indicators.name: Purchase of vessels, vehicles or boats and cash payments to boat suppliers
indicators.canon: Purchase of vessels, vehicles or boats and cash payments to boat suppliers
indicators.desc: Purchases of inflatable boats, engines, vans or lorries paid in cash by individuals with no business purpose.
indicators.ctx: Purchases of inflatable boats, engines, vans or lorries paid in cash by individuals with no business purpose.
indicators.fp: Hobbyists and small businesses buy boats and engines.

indicators.name: Accounts receiving numerous small deposits then immediate withdrawals near borders
indicators.canon: Accounts or flows in border regions with cross-border movement
indicators.desc: Accounts in border or transit areas show frequent deposits with matching cross-border transfers or rapid withdrawals.
indicators.ctx: Account in border or transit area receives funds from multiple foreign senders and cash is withdrawn within hours.
indicators.fp: Cross-border traders and workers may cluster.

indicators.name: Hotel, safe house or apartment payments for groups in transit hubs
indicators.canon: Hotel, safe house or apartment payments for groups in transit hubs
indicators.desc: Short stays booked for many persons, paid by one individual or cash.
indicators.ctx: Short stays booked for many persons, paid by one individual or cash.

indicators.name: Document fraud service payments
indicators.desc: Payments to document brokers, translators and forged document suppliers.
indicators.ctx: Payments to document brokers, translators and forged document suppliers.
indicators.fp: Legitimate translation and visa agencies exist.

indicators.name: Individuals receiving funds from many senders without family relation
indicators.canon: Account collecting funds from many unrelated payers
indicators.desc: A single account receives payments from numerous unrelated senders with no evident commercial or family link to the holder.
indicators.ctx: A single recipient collects funds from many unrelated senders in different countries.
indicators.fp: Community leaders and aid groups may collect donations.

indicators.name: Social-media-advertised travel services using payment apps
indicators.canon: Illicit sales or services advertised on social media or marketplaces with app or crypto payments
indicators.desc: Informal sellers or operators advertise online and collect payment through payment apps, crypto or unlabelled payments.
indicators.ctx: Informal operators promote crossing services and collect fees through payment apps or crypto.
indicators.fp: Genuine travel agents use social platforms.

indicators.name: Exit fees or debt bondage reports from customer
indicators.canon: Exit fees or debt bondage reports from customer
indicators.desc: Customer reveals owing large sums to a facilitator, or being pressured to repay.
indicators.ctx: Customer reveals owing large sums to a facilitator, or being pressured to repay.
indicators.fp: Customers may be owing legitimate loans.
